title: Aurora Home Rebates 2026: Xcel, Power Ahead Colorado and State Savings
desc: Aurora home rebates for 2026: Xcel heat pump, ducted heat pump, insulation, thermostat, EV charger and battery offers, the $1,500 Power Ahead Colorado rebate, and what closed.
badge: $1,500 regional heat pump rebate, plus Xcel and state offers
lead: Aurora has about 152,000 homes, and about 62% of households own theirs. Most of the homes are newer than Denver's, so the rebates that matter are often a heat pump to replace an aging air conditioner and a top-up of attic insulation. Xcel, the regional council and the state all pay.
cards_heading: What is open for Aurora homes in 2026
cards_intro: Xcel's amounts come from its 2026 rebate summary, last read September 29, 2026, because Xcel's pages load by script and would not open for our reader on October 5. The state, Colorado Energy Office and Power Ahead Colorado pages were read on October 5, 2026.

cards.title: Xcel heat pump
cards.note: Cold-climate air-source heat pumps, counted at 5°F. The higher rate is for homes heated with Xcel natural gas.

cards.title: Power Ahead Colorado heat pump rebate
cards.note: ENERGY STAR cold-climate air-source heat pump in an existing building, through a verified contractor, approved before work starts.

cards.title: State heat pump discount
cards.note: $83 for a heat pump water heater. Taken off your invoice by a registered contractor.

cards.title: Xcel heat pump water heater
cards.note: The higher amount is for gas-heated homes. ENERGY STAR, 3.3 UEF. The state adds at least $83.

cards.title: Xcel insulation and air sealing
cards.note: Attic up to $500, walls up to $350, air sealing up to $400. Gas-heated homes get 1.5 times the caps.

cards.title: Xcel EV charger and wiring
cards.note: Level 2 charger and/or 240V wiring. Up to $800 in a Disproportionately Impacted Community and up to $2,300 for income-qualified homes. Sign up for Optimize Your Charge first.

cards.title: Xcel Renewable Battery Connect
cards.note: $250 per kW of continuous power, with a battery charged by solar. $100 a year for five years on top.

cards.title: Xcel Solar Rewards
cards.note: For income-qualified homes and homes in a Disproportionately Impacted Community only in 2026. Other homes get net metering without an upfront payment.

cards.title: State income-based rebates (HEAR)
cards.note: Up to $14,000 per household while open. The single-family program is now closed.

cards.title: City of Aurora homeowner rebate
cards.note: Third-party sites list an Aurora heat pump rebate of a few hundred dollars. We could not read a city page that confirms it.

sections:
The American Community Survey (2020 to 2024) counts 152,377 homes in Aurora. About 62% of households own and 38% rent, and about 53% of homes are detached houses. Only 37% were built before 1980. About 29% were built in 2000 or later. Compared with Denver, Aurora has fewer older houses and more owners.

For an owner, the usual sequence is: look at the air conditioner's age, get the attic and air leaks checked, then decide on the heat pump. A heat pump that replaces an air conditioner also heats, so the extra cost of heating is smaller than when you add a heat pump on top of a working system.

About 62% of households heat with utility gas and 34% with electricity. The gas homes qualify for Xcel's higher gas-home rates on heat pumps, water heaters and weatherization if Xcel supplies the gas. The 34% on electricity is large, and for those homes a heat pump brings the biggest bill saving. See our Aurora heat pump page for a worked example with the ducted rebate.
Is Aurora part of the regional program

Power Ahead Colorado is run by the Denver Regional Council of Governments, and its FAQ names Aurora among the members. It covers Adams and Arapahoe counties, where Aurora sits. The rebate is for retrofit projects in existing buildings through a verified contractor, and your contractor confirms your address when they submit the project. New construction is not eligible.

The federal credits ended after 2025. The Colorado Energy Office closed its single-family income-based rebate program in August 2026; Aurora's counties were in the Front Range region. The state's invoice discount remains but fell to at least $333 for an air-source heat pump from $499.95 in 2024 and 2025.

Aggregator sites list an Aurora city heat pump rebate. We searched the city's own pages and could not find one that confirms it. Aurora's own page we did find is its Energy Action Plan, which is a planning document. If you find a current city rebate page, check its contractor and permit rules before you count on it.
claim_steps: Check your Xcel bill to see whether Xcel supplies both gas and electricity.
Ask for an attic insulation check and a blower door test.
Choose a contractor who is Xcel participating, Power Ahead Colorado verified and registered for the state discount.
Have heat pump projects submitted to Power Ahead Colorado before work starts.
Keep invoices and check the state discount line.
faq: What rebates can an Aurora homeowner get in 2026?

Xcel Energy rebates for heat pumps, water heaters, insulation, thermostats, EV chargers and batteries, the $1,500 Power Ahead Colorado rebate, and the state invoice discount. The state's income-based program and federal credits have closed.
Does Aurora have its own rebate?
We could not confirm one from a city page.
Is Aurora part of Power Ahead Colorado?
The program's FAQ names Aurora among the Denver Regional Council of Governments members. Your contractor confirms your address.
Are the Xcel heat pump amounts open yet?
Xcel's 2026 rebate summary lists them from October 1, 2026. Its page would not load for us, so confirm with Xcel.
Is the state's income-based program open?
No. The single-family program is closed.
